title: Get it in braille
warning: Computer-made braille, not yet proofread. Please check with a braille reader.
tactileNote: For swell paper (microcapsule) or a tactile embosser. Print at 100%.
columnNote: Column sums are written as linear calculations, for example 345 + 278 =.
intro: BRF files are for braille embossers and braille displays. Unicode braille text has the same cells and page layout. Tactile picture PDFs are for swell paper; shaded parts use hatching.
use: Take the files to your child’s vision teacher or school. Ask them to check the braille and adapt the pictures before use. The EPUB contains text descriptions and answers for libraries and braille transcription services.
license: Free to share and adapt under CC BY 4.0, with credit to Beequation (beequation.com).
scope: The worksheets and teachers’ puzzle pack are licensed under CC BY 4.0. The apps, browser game, Beequation name, logos and Indie the bee are not covered by this licence.
summary: All worksheets have headings, numbered questions, text descriptions of pictures and answers. No images are needed to read the content.
tableNote: English uses uncontracted Unified English Braille (UEB), including UEB maths. Other languages use their local uncontracted tables.
circle: A closed curved outline with no corners.
rectangle: Four right-angle corners, two longer and two shorter straight sides.
